bronze_saber.name: Bronze Saber
bronze_saber.description: A single-edged blade suited for fast, aggressive slashing techniques.

wolf_fang_saber.name: Wolf-Fang Saber
wolf_fang_saber.description: A heavily serrated blade that tears rather than cuts. Brutal in close quarters.

bloodmoon_saber.name: Bloodmoon Curved Saber
bloodmoon_saber.description: A long, deeply curved blade associated with demonic sects. The red tint in the metal is not cosmetic.
